scope.fixturePolicy: FIELD graph and LINE reference target are authored in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture files were added.
qualified: Counted FIELD object handles use group 97 and repeated group 331 soft-pointer IDs.
Main and keyed child values cover the current integer (library types 0 and 1), real (type 2), string (type 4), binary (type 8), and ID (type 64) serializer branches.
Resolved target references follow the emitted entity handle when the writer remaps its source handle.
An unresolved ID is refused without replacing an existing destination; correcting it succeeds on the same adapter instance.
notQualified: Autodesk documents the FIELD wire groups, but does not assign the library's numeric DRW_CadValue type constants; numeric values above identify the existing implementation branches exercised by this test.
Coordinate values (library types 16 and 32) and producer/version profiles beyond this generated AC1027 graph.
Native FIELD expression evaluation, computed values, or semantic acceptance by an independent CAD application.
A DWG source producer profile or source-to-output semantic association.

authority.title: Autodesk AutoCAD 2021 FIELD (DXF)
supports: FIELD child data uses a group-93 dataset count and repeated group-6 key/value records.
Group 97 counts object IDs used by the field code; repeated group 331 values are soft-pointer IDs.
The documented value wire groups include group 91 for long values, group 140 for double values, group 330 for ID values, and groups 92/310 for binary values.

implementation.admission: The FIELD output profile admits only the tested integer, real, string, binary, and resolved-ID forms for main and keyed child values. Coordinates and unknown forms remain refused.
implementation.serialization: The existing FIELD serializer writes the documented group forms and applies the object-handle remapper to groups 331 and type-64 group 330 values.

observations: The same generated FIELD graph roundtrips in ASCII and Binary DXF.
Main and child typed payloads retain their values, data types, group codes, keyed association, and binary bytes.
Object-ID values and group-331 references resolve to the remapped LINE handle on readback.
A deliberately unresolved main CadValue ID preserves the destination sentinel; correction permits same-adapter retry.
